items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Red was always my boy, around Grand Central.

ctx.x: Oh, I'd say around '46 or '47. But, we're talking about, jumping back to '28 now. This day I'd bought myself a new suit, Stan, and I'd got this new suit. I had a cat over there that plays ... so he says, You want another suit, huh? I said, Yeah. I know why you want a new suit. I said, How did you know I wanted a new suit? He said, Because Louis Armstrong is in town. That's in the levee days, ... and a cat by the name of Red. So we had a date and he had to make a lot of change of cars to get to Webster Groves so…
You don't know his other name, just Red?
